# morfem

> Schemaless, transactional document database with a CouchDB-shaped HTTP API. SQLite under the hood (rusqlite natively, D1 on Cloudflare Workers). JSON docs with integer `_rev`, Mango `_find` queries, `_changes` feed, multi-doc `/_txn` transactions via optimistic concurrency, bearer-token auth with read/write/admin roles.

Paths below are relative to this file's URL. The full documentation in one file is `llms-full.txt`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](getting-started.md): run locally, deploy to Cloudflare Workers, first curl requests
- [npm package](npm.md): `morfem`, run in-process on Node, Bun, Deno, browsers, Workers; custom stores
- [HTTP API](api.md): endpoints, document and `_rev` rules, error format
- [Queries](queries.md): `_all_docs`, Mango `_find` operators, indexes, `_changes`
- [Transactions](transactions.md): `/_txn` reads, guards, ops, retry pattern
- [Auth and limits](auth-and-limits.md): `MORFEM_KEYS`, roles, naming rules, size limits

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): all of the above concatenated
